name: Golden Circle in a day
description_md:
Golden Circle in a day is a one day city sightseeing walk between the city's main sights in IS. The day is anchored in Golden Circle and features 4 sightseeing stops.

The route covers 8.2 km of walking between stops. The full day takes about 5.3 hours, visit time at each stop included.
